title: Documentation claim verification gate
description: Deduplicate the analytical claims in a description, verify each against attested tokens, corpus evidence, and variation data, and block archiving while any is unverified.
yaml:
apiVersion: ladder.dev/v1alpha1
kind: Workflow
metadata:
  name: wf-ling-01
  title: Documentation claim verification gate
  description: Deduplicate the analytical claims in a description, verify each against attested tokens,
    corpus evidence, and variation data, and block archiving while any is unverified.
  version: 1.0.0
spec:
  objective: Archive a language description in which every generalization cites an attested form, and
    unattested paradigm cells are marked rather than filled by analogy.
  policies:
    maxConcurrency: 4
    onFailure: preserve-completed
    requireApprovalFor:
      - n-approval
  nodes:
    - id: n-intake
      kind: input
      name: Draft description and recorded material
      summary: Draft description and recorded material
      inputSchema:
        type: object
        required:
          - text
        properties:
          text:
            type: string
            description: The requester's objective, source material, or instructions.
          workflowFields:
            type: object
            required:
              - draft_generalizations
              - recorded_tokens
              - corpus
              - consent_and_access_terms
            properties:
              draft_generalizations: {}
              recorded_tokens: {}
              corpus: {}
              consent_and_access_terms: {}
        x-ladder-input-mode: document
    - id: n-dedupe
      kind: transform
      name: Deduplicate claim set
      summary: deduplicate draft_generalizations by normalized claim so each is verified once
      config:
        operation: deduplicate
        expression: deduplicate draft_generalizations by normalized claim so each is verified once
    - id: n-verify1
      kind: agent
      templateRef: ling-02
      name: Verify against attested tokens
      summary: 'Verification pass 1: verify against attested tokens.'
      role: Analyst building phonological and morphological descriptions from attested data.
      prompt: You are a Phonological & Morphological Analyst. You build descriptions from attested forms,
        cite the token behind every generalization, and mark a paradigm cell unattested rather than filling
        it by analogy. You distinguish a rule the data supports from a pattern you expect from related
        languages, because the second is how a described language quietly becomes a copy of its neighbour.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - decision-analysis
          - evaluation
          - domain-analysis
        tools:
          - read
          - calculate
        connectors: []
        permissions:
          - read-only
      outputSchema:
        type: object
        required:
          - verified
          - unverified
          - evidence
        properties:
          verified: {}
          unverified: {}
          evidence: {}
    - id: n-verify2
      kind: agent
      templateRef: ling-03
      name: Verify against corpus frequency and citation
      summary: 'Verification pass 2: verify against corpus frequency and citation.'
      role: Specialist building corpora and dictionary entries that stay checkable.
      prompt: You are a Corpus & Lexicography Specialist. You build corpora with documented sampling and
        annotation guidelines, and you write dictionary entries where each sense is supported by citations
        from the corpus. You record frequency and register honestly, including where the corpus is too
        small to support a claim about either.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - domain-analysis
          - privacy-review
          - evidence-verification
          - statistical-analysis
        tools:
          - read
          - search
        connectors:
          - mcp:archive
        permissions:
          - read-only
      outputSchema:
        type: object
        required:
          - verified
          - unverified
          - evidence
        properties:
          verified: {}
          unverified: {}
          evidence: {}
    - id: n-verify3
      kind: agent
      templateRef: ling-05
      name: Verify against variation across speakers
      summary: 'Verification pass 3: verify against variation across speakers.'
      role: Analyst describing variation without treating one variety as the standard.
      prompt: You are a Dialect & Variation Analyst. You describe variation across region, community,
        and register using attested data and explicit social variables, and you avoid framing any variety
        as a deviation from a standard. You state sample sizes per variety, because claims about a community
        based on a handful of speakers are sociolinguistically and ethically fragile.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - decision-analysis
          - design-review
          - statistical-analysis
          - writing-editing
        tools:
          - read
          - calculate
        connectors: []
        permissions:
          - read-only
      outputSchema:
        type: object
        required:
          - verified
          - unverified
          - evidence
        properties:
          verified: {}
          unverified: {}
          evidence: {}
    - id: n-collect
      kind: aggregator
      name: Collect verification results
      summary: Source-tag every verification result so an unverified item stays attributable.
      config:
        aggregation: collect
    - id: n-unresolved
      kind: condition
      name: Any unverified items?
      summary: Route on collected.unverified is empty.
      config:
        expression: collected.unverified is empty
        branches:
          - label: Clear
            when: clear
          - label: Unverified remain
            when: unverified
    - id: n-resolve
      kind: agent
      templateRef: ling-01
      name: Mark unattested claims or withdraw them
      summary: Close, replace, or explicitly withdraw each unverified item.
      role: Field linguist documenting a language with speaker consent and archival standards.
      prompt: You are a Field Documentation Linguist. You produce recordings, transcriptions, and metadata
        to archival standard with speaker consent, access conditions, and provenance recorded for every
        item. You document what speakers actually say rather than normalizing it toward a prestige variety,
        and you keep the community's stated access restrictions attached to the material permanently.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - writing-editing
          - compliance-review
          - domain-analysis
          - audio-processing
          - de-identification
        tools:
          - read
          - write
        connectors:
          - mcp:archive
        permissions:
          - read-only
          - pii-restricted
      outputSchema:
        type: object
    - id: n-approval
      kind: approval
      name: Community representative and archive lead approve deposit
      summary: Pause for the community representative and archive lead; on timeout, escalate.
    - id: workflow-output
      kind: output
      name: Released deliverable
      summary: Return the completed Documentation claim verification gate deliverable, the evidence behind
        it, and every unresolved item.
  edges:
    - id: wf-ling-01-edge-1
      from: n-intake
      to: n-dedupe
      kind: data
    - id: wf-ling-01-edge-2
      from: n-dedupe
      to: n-verify1
      kind: data
    - id: wf-ling-01-edge-3
      from: n-dedupe
      to: n-verify2
      kind: data
    - id: wf-ling-01-edge-4
      from: n-dedupe
      to: n-verify3
      kind: data
    - id: wf-ling-01-edge-5
      from: n-verify1
      to: n-collect
      kind: data
    - id: wf-ling-01-edge-6
      from: n-verify2
      to: n-collect
      kind: data
    - id: wf-ling-01-edge-7
      from: n-verify3
      to: n-collect
      kind: data
    - id: wf-ling-01-edge-8
      from: n-collect
      to: n-unresolved
      kind: data
    - id: wf-ling-01-edge-9
      from: n-unresolved
      to: n-approval
      kind: control
      condition: clear
    - id: wf-ling-01-edge-10
      from: n-unresolved
      to: n-resolve
      kind: control
      condition: unverified
    - id: wf-ling-01-edge-11
      from: n-resolve
      to: n-approval
      kind: data
    - id: wf-ling-01-edge-12
      from: n-approval
      to: workflow-output
      kind: dependency
      condition: approved
